{"script":"cat > count_logs.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
if [ $# -ne 1 ]; then
  echo "Usage: $0 YYYY-MM" >&2
  exit 2
fi
month="$1"
cd logs || { echo 0; exit 0; }
shopt -s nullglob
count=0
for f in "$month"-*.log; do
  if [ -f "$f" ]; then
    ((count++))
  fi
done
echo "$count"
EOF
chmod +x count_logs.sh
# show script content briefly
sed -n '1,120p' count_logs.sh
"}
